note: First version: the signed-out screen the Pixelfed adapter built in code

component.doc: Pixelfed's sign-in: a sentence naming the server, a 'Sign in with Pixelfed' button for it, and, when other servers are allowed, a server box with its own button. The pod serves it as the Pixelfed blueprint's signed-out screen; a layout can use it too (the buttons start the pod's Pixelfed sign-in, action.auth.login).

params.name: server
params.doc: The server the sentence names, e.g. pixelfed.social.

params.name: instance_url
params.doc: The server 'Sign in with Pixelfed' signs in to, e.g. https://pixelfed.social.

params.name: other_servers
params.doc: Offer a box to sign in to another server (local:providers#custom_server says whether the pod allows it).

children.value_expr: Sign in to $arg.server to see your home feed. Your Pixelfed token stays on your pod.
Or sign in to another Pixelfed server:

examples.note: One server: the sentence and its button.
Other servers allowed: the server box and its button too.
